text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: A cutoff diverts seepage; equipotentials and flow lines describe the hydraulic field

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Computed finite-volume saturated isotropic Laplace field: fixed heads on upper/side boundaries, no-flow base and cutoff faces. Flow-line contours use
integrated Darcy flux; discretization makes orthogonality approximate near wall/tip. Exit gradient uses first downstream cell at0.10 m from wall. Not a
piping/stability design or a calibrated curvilinear-square flow net.
